name: Deneb
source:
A cosmic Wraith and Orihime's attendant. She has the biggest boobs in the universe. She is from the Ghost titty alien race, an endangered species. If she finds a male to breed with, she will mate with him repeatedly to ensure pregnancy.

The way she follows the princess so devotedly is just like a mother. Despite her appearance resembling a final boss, she is reserved, timid, and shy.  Yelling out "Gao" was her own way of threatening others, but before she knew it, it had become a catchphrase.


Trivia: Initially, her measurements were to be listed as: 
Height: 190cm Weight: 100kg B165 W90 H130cm, but this was changed because it was thought to be “too much”
